req.title: Health responds under load-balancer probe path
req.statement: The system shall serve GET /health/ with sub-second latency and no external dependencies required.
triggers: health responds under load-balancer probe path

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /health/ endpoint should respond with sub-second latency and no external dependencies, ensuring the system's health check is efficient and reliable. The test suite includes positive, negative, and boundary cases to validate the endpoint's behavior under different conditions.

tests.name: test_health_endpoint_positive
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /health/ endpoint.
expected: The response time is less than 1 second.
trace: Requirement R-PLAYER-039: The system shall serve GET /health/ with sub-second latency.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import time

client = TestClient(app)
start_time = time.time()
response = client.get('/health/')
end_time = time.time()

assert response.status_code == 200
assert (end_time - start_time) < 1

tests.name: test_health_endpoint_boundary
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /health/ endpoint multiple times in quick succession.
expected: Each response time is less than 1 second.
trace: Requirement R-PLAYER-039: The system shall serve GET /health/ with sub-second latency.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import time

client = TestClient(app)
for _ in range(5):
    start_time = time.time()
    response = client.get('/health/')
    end_time = time.time()
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert (end_time - start_time) < 1
